careInstructions:
Care Instructions
Melton Wool
Care for your melton wool varsity jacket like a suit, not a hoodie. Brush off dust after each game or class. Spot clean marks with cool water and a tiny bit of wool soap. If it needs a wash, use cold water, gentle motion, and short time. Lay the jacket flat on a towel and shape the ribs and cuffs while damp. Keep it away from heat and strong sun.

Do: Use a soft clothes brush after wearing.
Do: Air the jacket in shade, not sun.
Do not: Machine wash on heavy cycle or use bleach.
Do not: Tumble dry or hang it soaking wet.
Vegan / Faux Leather (PU / Vinyl)
Vegan faux leather varsity and bomber jackets clean up fast if you avoid harsh products. Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Rinse with a fresh damp cloth and dry with a towel. Hang the jacket in a cool place so the coating does not crack or peel.

Do: Wipe spills and sweat marks as soon as you see them.
Do: Hang on a sturdy hanger to avoid deep creases.
Do not: Use acetone, alcohol, or strong stain removers.
Do not: Leave the jacket in hot cars or near strong heat.
